title: PailitaoMMSearch2.0 Technical Report: Scaling Generative Retrieval to Unified End-to-End Multimodal Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.36958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative retrieval models have been increasingly adopted in search and recommendation systems. However, industrial generative retrieval models are commonly specialized to a fixed online scenario: they learn from scenario-specific interactions, support a narrow set of query forms and retrieval objectives. We study how to remove these couplings and build a unified end-to-end multimodal search system for open-ended image--text queries, heterogeneous shopping intents, and online scenarios with different resource constraints. We present \textbf{PailitaoMMSearch}, which directly generates product Semantic IDs from a raw query image and free-form instruction and scales along three dimensions. \textbf{Data scaling} uses a reusable toolset that can be composed into intent- and lifecycle-specific workflows for cold-start synthesis, quality control, real-traffic refinement, and continuous data production. \textbf{Intent scaling} progressively e

translated_title: 拍立淘MMSearch2.0技术报告：将生成式检索扩展至统一的端到端多模态搜索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索模型在搜索和推荐系统中的应用日益广泛。然而，工业界的生成式检索模型通常专门针对固定的在线场景：它们从场景特定的交互中学习，仅支持狭窄的查询形式和检索目标。我们研究了如何消除这些耦合，构建一个统一的端到端多模态搜索系统，以支持开放式的图文查询、异构的购物意图以及具有不同资源约束的在线场景。我们提出了拍立淘MMSearch，它可以直接从原始查询图像和自由形式指令生成商品语义ID，并在三个维度上进行扩展。数据扩展使用可复用的工具集，可组合成针对特定意图和生命周期的工作流，用于冷启动合成、质量控制、真实流量细化和持续数据生产。意图扩展逐步（摘要原文在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出了拍立淘MMSearch，一个统一的端到端多模态生成式检索系统，可直接从原始查询图像和自由形式指令生成商品语义ID，并在数据、意图等三个维度上扩展，以支持开放式图文查询、异构购物意图和不同资源约束的在线场景。
en_tdlr: PailitaoMMSearch is a unified end-to-end multimodal generative retrieval system that directly generates product Semantic IDs from raw query images and free-form instructions, scaling along three dimensions (data, intent, and more) to support open-ended image-text queries, heterogeneous shopping intents, and online scenarios with diverse resource constraints.
